battle.name: 第二次世界大戰
battle.brief: 第二次世界大戰於1939年9月1日德國入侵波蘭後全面爆發，橫跨歐洲、非洲與亞洲，牽動全球主要強權。此戰期間，德國空軍的梅塞施密特Bf 109戰鬥機自1937年起服役，成為歐洲戰場上的關鍵空中力量。

kit.name: 梅塞施密特Bf 109戰鬥機
kit.history: 做為納粹德國空軍的主力單座戰鬥機，Bf 109在歐洲戰場上肩負制空任務，與盟軍戰機交戰。

countries: 第二次世界大戰於1939年9月1日爆發，交戰雙方主要由軸心國與同盟國陣營構成。軸心國包括納粹德國、法西斯義大利與軍國主義日本，其中德國在歐洲战场上凭借其龐大的機械化兵團與空軍力量主導進攻；義大利軍隊在北非與巴爾幹半島提供輔助牽制；日本則在遠東展開對華侵略並於1941年12月偷襲珍珠港，將美國直接拉入戰爭。同盟國陣營以英國與法國為首，法國在1939年動員約250萬兵力防守馬奇諾防線，英國則凭借皇家海軍與皇家空軍維持海上與空中優勢；蘇聯於1939年與德國簽署《蘇德互不侵犯條例》，却在1941年6月遭受德國「巴巴羅薩」行動的侵略，加入同盟國；美國在珍珠港事變後於1941年12月8日向軸心國宣戰，投入龐大的工業與人力資源。整體而言，軸心國的快速機械化與同盟國的資源動員形成鮮明對比，交織出多條戰線的複雜局面。
countriesEn: World War II erupted on 1 September 1939, with the principal belligerents organized into the Axis and the Allied camps. The Axis comprised Nazi Germany, Fascist Italy and militarist Japan; Germany dominated the European theater with its massive mechanized corps and air power, Italy provided auxiliary forces in North Africa and the Balkans, and Japan pursued a full‑scale invasion of China before attacking Pearl Harbor in December 1941, dragging the United States into the conflict. The Allied side was led by Britain and France – France mobilized roughly 2.5 million men to defend the Maginot Line, while Britain relied on the Royal Navy and Royal Air Force to maintain sea and air superiority. The Soviet Union, after signing the Molotov‑Ribbentrop Pact with Germany in 1939, was invaded in June 1941 in Operation Barbarossa and joined the Allies. The United States declared war on the Axis on 8 December 1941, committing its enormous industrial and manpower resources. Overall, the Axis' rapid mechanization contrasted sharply with the Allies' resource mobilization, creating a complex multi‑front war.
people: 在歐洲戰場，德國的最高統帥部由阿道夫·希特勒親自執掌，並依賴陸軍元帥格爾德·馮·龍德施泰特與埃里希·馮·曼斯坦等將領的戰術判斷，實施「閃電戰」運動戰；德國空軍的司令赫爾曼·戈林則負責策劃與執行大規模空中轟炸。英國方面，溫斯頓·丘吉爾以首相身份統籌全局，指揮本土防禦；皇家空軍的「颱風」與「噴火」中隊由空軍上將休·道丁領導，於1940年的英吉利海峽空战中取得關鍵勝利。法國的最高軍事會議由莫里斯·甘末林與馬克西姆·魏剛等人主導，試圖以靜態防禦抵擋德軍突破。蘇聯的紅軍在1941年遭到德軍的突如其來進攻後，由元帥格奧爾基·朱可夫與伊萬·科涅夫元帥組織後備兵團，展開大規模的游擊與正規戰。在遠東，日本帝國的陸軍大臣東條英機與海軍大將山本五十六策劃對美、英、荷的太平洋作戰，珍珠港偷襲即由山本策劃並於1941年12月7日實施。這些指揮官的決策與協調直接塑造了戰役的走向與結果。
peopleEn: In Europe, Germany's supreme command was exercised directly by Adolf Hitler, with senior officers such as Generals Gerd von Rundstedt and Erich von Manstein shaping the Blitzkrieg doctrine that combined armor, motorised infantry and Luftwaffe support. Hermann Göring, commander of the German Air Force, directed large‑scale bombing campaigns. Britain was led by Prime Minister Winston Churchill, who coordinated home defense, while Air Chief Marshal Hugh Dowding commanded the RAF's Hurricane and Spitfire squadrons, achieving decisive victory in the 1940 Battle of Britain. France's High Command, headed by Maurice Gamelin and Maxime Weygand, relied on static defenses along the Maginot Line. The Soviet Red Army, after the surprise German invasion, reorganised under Marshals Georgy Zhukov and Ivan Konev, conducting massive partisan and conventional operations. In the Far East, Japanese Army Minister Hideki Tojo and Admiral Isoroku Yamamoto orchestrated attacks on the United States, Britain and the Netherlands, with the Pearl Harbor raid on 7 December 1941 being Yamamoto's brainchild. The decisions and coordination of these commanders directly shaped the course and outcome of the campaigns.
kits: 1939年各主要交戰國已大量列裝當代武器系統。德國裝甲兵團的主力包括Panzerkampfwagen III（配備3.7cm KwK 37/38坦克炮）與Panzerkampfwagen IV（配備7.5cm KwK 37坦克炮），以及少數Panzerkampfwagen I與II用於偵察；此外，、德國的突擊砲兵配備15 cm sIG 33步兵炮與10.5 cm leIG 18輕型步兵炮，提供近距離支援。德國空軍的主力戰鬥機為Messerschmitt Bf 109，配備805 km/h的最高速度與1挺7.92mm MG 17機槍；轟炸機則有Heinkel He 111，載彈量約2,000公斤，可執行戰略轟炸。英國皇家空軍使用Hawker Hurricane與Supermarine Spitfire，兩者均裝備8挺7.7mm口徑的白朗寧機槍，火力足以對付德軍轟炸機；英國陸軍則配備Matilda I與Matilda II步兵坦克，裝甲厚達78mm，具備良好防護。蘇聯在1939年仍大量使用T-26輕型坦克與BT-5、BT-7快速坦克，配備45mm Model 32坦克炮，適合快速機動；步兵武器包括Mosin-Nagant M1891/30步槍與DP-27輕機槍。法國軍隊裝備Renault R35、Somua S-35等步兵坦克，口徑為37mm與47mm；空軍則有Morane-Saulner 406戰鬥機與Potez 630雙座戰鬥機。這些裝備的技術特性與數量直接決定了各戰場的火力對比與作戰效能。
kitsEn: By 1939 the major combatants had fielded a wide array of contemporary weapons. Germany's armoured divisions were built around the Panzerkampfwagen III (equipped with a 3.7 cm KwK 37/38 gun) and the Panzerkampfwagen IV (with a 7.5 cm KwK 37 gun), supplemented by lighter Panzerkampfwagen I and II tanks for reconnaissance; the German infantry received the 15 cm sIG 33 and 10.5 cm leIG 18 howitzers for close support. The Luftwaffe's primary fighter was the Messerschmitt Bf 109, capable of 805 km/h and armed with a single 7.92 mm MG 17 machine gun, while the Heinkel He 111 bomber could carry up to 2,000 kg of bombs for strategic missions. The Royal Air Force operated Hawker Hurricanes and Supermarine Spitfires, each fitted with eight 7.7 mm Browning machine guns, sufficient to down German bombers. British army tanks included the Matilda I and the heavily armoured Matilda II (78 mm of protection). The Soviet Union still relied heavily on the T‑26 light tank, and the BT‑5/BT‑7 fast tanks, both armed with a 45 mm Model 32 gun; infantry weapons comprised the Mosin‑Nagant M1891/30 rifle and the DP‑27 light machine gun. France fielded the Renault R35 and Somua S‑35 infantry tanks, armed with 37 mm and 47 mm guns respectively, and the Morane‑Saulner 406 fighter alongside the Potez 630 twin‑seat fighter. The technical characteristics and quantities of these systems determined firepower ratios and combat effectiveness on every front.
tactics: 二戰初期，德國軍隊以「閃電戰」為核心戰術，將裝甲師、摩托化步兵與 Luftwaffe 的近距支援相結合，運用快速的側翼包圍與分割殲滅敵軍主力。德軍第1裝甲師與第2裝甲師在波蘭戰役中沿「波蘭走廊」與「西里西亞」兩路同時突破，通過鐵路與公路快速集結補給，使用「裝甲縱隊」與「自行火砲」保持持續火力，迫使波蘭守軍在兩週內崩潰。法國方面則依賴馬奇諾防線的靜態防御，兵力配置以師為單位，纵深部署防線，配備混凝土掩體與火力交叉点，旨在以消耗戰削弱德軍攻勢。然而，當德軍於1940年5月穿過阿登山脈的森林道路，實施「分割」與「鉗形」包圍時，法軍的防線被瞬間突破，導致防線整體崩潰。英國在本土防禦中則以「空軍優势」為主，通過皇家空軍的「攔截」與「雷達預警」系統，及時發現並攔截德國轟炸機羣，採用「密集編隊」與「垂直翻轉」等機動飛行戰術，以最小損失取得制空權。蘇聯在東線則實施「大兵團」與「側面迂回」戰術，利用鐵路與河流的自然障礙，指揮多兵種协同作战，強調「兵力集中」與「快速突穿」，在1942年的斯大林格勒戰役中，通過城市巷戰與殘酷的近距離搏鬥，成功遏制德軍的進攻。整體而言，各國根據自身資源與技術條件選擇不同的作戰方式，形成機械化快速打擊與靜態消耗戰兩種主流模式。
tacticsEn: Early in the war Germany employed Blitzkrieg as its core tactic, integrating armored divisions, motorised infantry and Luftwaffe close‑support aircraft into a combined‑arms force that used rapid flanking maneuvers to encircle and annihilate enemy concentrations. German 1st and 2nd Panzer divisions in the Polish campaign advanced simultaneously along the Polish Corridor and through Silesia, maintaining continuous fire with armored columns and self‑propelled artillery while using railways and highways for swift supply. This pressure forced Polish forces to collapse within two weeks. France, by contrast, placed its faith in the Maginot Line's static fortifications, deploying divisions in depth with concrete emplacements and interlocking fields of fire intended to wear down attackers through attrition. When German forces in May 1940 exploited the forested Ardennes to break through and encircle the French armies, the static line was shattered, leading to rapid collapse. Britain's home defense relied on air superiority, using RAF interceptors guided by radar to vector Hurricane and Spitfire squadrons against incoming bomber formations, employing tight formations and rapid vertical reversals to achieve decisive air control with minimal losses. The Soviet Union, after the 1941 invasion, applied mass‑concentration tactics combined with wide flanking maneuvers along natural obstacles such as rivers and railways, emphasizing coordinated multi‑arm operations. During the Battle of Stalingrad in 1942‑43, Soviet forces engaged in brutal street‑to‑street combat, halting the German advance through close‑quarter fighting and counter‑offensives. Overall, each nation tailored its operational methods to its own resources and technology, producing two dominant models: mechanised, high‑speed assault and static, attritional defense.
data: 根據已公開的歷史資料，1939年9月的波蘭戰役，德國投入兵力約150萬人、坦克約2,500輛、作戰飛機約1,350架，彈藥消耗包括105mm榴彈炮彈約120萬發、150mm步兵炮彈約50萬發，波蘭守軍約100萬人、坦克880輛，最終波蘭方面約66,000人阵亡、約130,000人受傷、約694,000人被俘，德軍則約16,000人阵亡、約30,000人受傷。1940年法國戰役中，德軍集結兵力約300萬人、坦克3,000輛、作戰飛機5,500架，發動「黃色計畫」與「赤色計畫」兩階段進攻，法軍兵力約250萬人、坦克2,400輛，傷亡約85,000人阵亡、約120,000人受傷、約180,000人被俘，德軍傷亡約27,000人阵亡、約111,000人受傷。1940年英吉利海峽空战，英國空軍損失約544名飛行員，德國損失約2,000名機組人員；皇家海軍在保衛海上交通線中損失軍艦約30艘。德軍於1941年6月發起「巴巴羅薩」行動，投入兵力約330萬人、坦克3,000輛、作戰飛機2,000架，蘇聯則动员约540萬人、坦克約24,000輛（包括T-26、BT-7等），首六個月蘇軍約400萬人被俘或阵亡，德軍約50萬人伤亡。1942年至1943年的斯大林格勒戰役，雙方累计兵力約200萬人，城內建築物與地下工事消耗彈藥包括122mm與152mm榴彈炮彈共約130萬發，整體傷亡約200萬人，其中蘇軍约110萬人阵亡或被俘，德軍约85萬人伤亡。這些數據顯示，隨著戰爭規模的擴大，兵力與物資消耗呈指數級增長，對各國的工業與后勤系統提出極大挑戰。
dataEn: Published historical records provide the following figures. In the September 1939 Polish campaign Germany deployed roughly 1.5 million men, 2,500 tanks and 1,350 aircraft, expending about 1.2 million rounds of 105 mm shells and 500,000 rounds of 150 mm shells; Poland fielded about 1 million men, 880 tanks and suffered roughly 66,000 killed, 130,000 wounded and 694,000 captured, while German casualties were about 16,000 dead and 30,000 wounded. In the 1940 French campaign Germany assembled about 3 million troops, 3,000 tanks and 5,500 aircraft, launching the 'Yellow' and 'Red' plans; France mobilized roughly 2.5 million men and 2,400 tanks, losing about 85,000 dead, 120,000 wounded and 180,000 captured, with German losses at 27,000 dead and 111,000 wounded. The Battle of Britain saw the RAF lose about 544 pilots while the Luftwaffe lost roughly 2,000 aircrew; the Royal Navy's merchant‑convoy protection cost about 30 warships. Operation Barbarossa in June 1941 involved about 3.3 million German troops, 3,000 tanks and 2,000 aircraft against a Soviet force of about 5.4 million men and 24,000 tanks (including T‑26 and BT‑7 models), resulting in approximately 4 million Soviet prisoners and dead in the first six months and about 500,000 German casualties. The Battle of Stalingrad (1942‑43) saw roughly 2 million combatants committed, with urban fighting consuming about 1.3 million rounds of 122 mm and 152 mm shells; total casualties approached 2 million, including about 1.1 million Soviet dead or captured and roughly 850,000 German casualties. These numbers illustrate the exponential growth of manpower and material consumption as the war expanded, placing unprecedented strain on each nation's industrial and logistical systems.
cause: 第二次世界大戰的根本起因可追溯至第一次世界大戰結束後的《凡爾賽條約》對德國的嚴苛制裁與領土割讓，導致德國民族主義情緒高漲、經濟危機加劇，為納粹黨的崛起提供土壤；同時，德國對於「生存空間」的擴張主義論述在希特勒的《我的奮鬥》中得到系統化闡述，成為其對外侵略的正當化基礎。日本方面，1920年代的大正民主與1930年代的軍部主導，使其確信在亞洲建立「大東亞共榮圈」能夠获取資源與市場，遂於1937年發動全面侵華戰爭，並在1940年與德、意簽署《三國同盟條約》，形成軸心國的軍事合作框架。此外，歐洲的綏靖政策——特別是英法對德國在萊茵蘭、奧地利及捷克斯洛伐克的擴張行動的姑息——助長了德國的侵略信心；最後，蘇德互不侵犯條約的簽署虽暂时缓和了蘇德關係，却讓希特勒確信在進攻西線後不會受到蘇聯的夾擊，從而加快了戰爭的爆發。這些政治、經濟與意識形態因素交織，最終在1939年9月1日德國入侵波蘭時觸發全面戰爭。
causeEn: The deep roots of World War II lie in the harsh penalties imposed on Germany by the Treaty of Versailles after World War I, which fueled German nationalism, economic distress and the rise of the Nazi Party; Hitler's 'Mein Kampf' articulated an expansionist 'Lebensraum' doctrine that justified territorial conquest. Japan, following a decade of militarist dominance after the Taisho democracy period, pursued the creation of a 'Greater East Asia Co‑Prosperity Sphere' to secure resources and markets, launching a full‑scale war against China in 1937 and aligning with Germany and Italy in the Tripartite Pact of 1940. European appeasement—particularly Britain and France's tolerance of German remilitarisation of the Rhineland, annexation of Austria and dismemberment of Czechoslovakia—emboldened Hitler's ambitions. The Molotov‑Ribbentrop Pact, while temporarily easing Soviet‑German tensions, gave Hitler confidence that he could attack western Europe without fear of a Soviet rear guard, accelerating the slide toward war. These political, economic and ideological factors converged on 1 September 1939, when Germany invaded Poland, triggering a global conflict.
impact: 二戰的規模與影響遠超先前任何衝突，帶來深遠的軍事、政治與社會變革。軍事層面，大規模的機械化戰爭與空中轟炸改變了傳統戰鬥的概念，「總體戰」模式要求國家動員全部資源到前線與後勤，導致工業生產與人力資源的配置成為戰爭成敗的關鍵。政治上，軸心國的失敗與同盟國的勝利確立了美國與蘇聯兩大超級強國的崛起，戰後的勢力範圍重新劃分，形成以美國為首的西方陣營與以蘇聯為首的東方陣營，直接孕育了冷戰的格局。社會層面，戰爭造成約6,000萬至8,000萬人死亡，估計約3,500萬人受傷，導致歐洲大片城鎮被夷為平地，數百萬人流離失所，促成了戰後的「嬰兒潮」與大規模的移民潮。經濟上，美國的《租借法案》與馬歇爾計畫在戰後重建西歐，推動了跨大西洋經濟一體化，並確立了美元在全球金融體系中的主導地位；蘇聯則在東歐建立計劃經濟體系，形成與西方市場經濟的對立。文化上，戰爭促使了國際組織如聯合國的成立，旨在通過集體安全機制防止類似衝突再次發生，並制定了《世界人權宣言》以保護人類基本權利。這些深遠的影響塑造了20世紀後半葉的國際秩序，並持續作用於今日的地緣政治格局。
impactEn: The scale and consequences of World War II far exceeded any previous conflict, producing profound military, political and social transformations. Militarily, the widespread use of mechanised warfare and strategic bombing altered traditional combat concepts; the 'total war' model demanded the full mobilization of a nation's resources for front‑line and logistical support, turning industrial output and manpower into decisive factors. Politically, the defeat of the Axis and the victory of the Allies elevated the United States and the Soviet Union to super‑power status, reshaping the post‑war order into an American‑led Western bloc and a Soviet‑dominated Eastern bloc, directly spawning the Cold War. Socially, the war caused an estimated 60‑80 million deaths and roughly 35 million wounded, with entire European cities reduced to rubble and millions displaced, prompting a post‑war baby boom and large‑scale migrations. Economically, the United States' Lend‑Lease programme and the subsequent Marshall Plan rebuilt Western Europe, fostering trans‑Atlantic economic integration and cementing the dollar's dominant role in the global financial system, while the Soviet Union established centrally planned economies in Eastern Europe, creating a competing model. Culturally, the conflict spurred the creation of the United Nations, designed to provide collective security and prevent future wars, and led to the adoption of the Universal Declaration of Human Rights. These deep‑seated changes shaped the latter half of the twentieth century and continue to influence today's geopolitical landscape.
result: 二戰的最終結果是軸心國的全面的軍事失敗與同盟國的全面勝利。德國於1945年5月8日在柏林的德意志帝國投降儀式上正式無條件投降，標誌著歐洲戰場的結束；同日，日本在東京灣的密蘇里號戰艦上簽署投降書，於同年9月2日正式結束太平洋戰爭。戰後，德國被分割為東西部，柏林同樣被分占，納粹政權被解散，戰犯接受紐倫堡審判；日本天皇制的政治結構得以保留，但軍部勢力被剷除，接受東京審判與其他地區的戰犯審判。蘇聯在東歐建立了共產主義政權，形成蘇聯勢力範圍；美國則在西歐與日本、韓國等國建立民主制度的同盟體系。冷戰的對峙格局在1947年至1991年間持續，雙方在核武器、太空競賽及代理戰爭中展開激烈競爭。整體而言，軸心國的失敗導致了國際秩序的根本重塑，確立了以聯合國為核心的多邊安全機制，並為後續的全球化、經濟一體化與人權保障提供了制度框架。
resultEn: The ultimate outcome of World War II was the complete military defeat of the Axis powers and the total victory of the Allies. Germany formally surrendered unconditionally on 8 May 1945 in Berlin, ending the European conflict; Japan signed the instrument of surrender aboard the USS Missouri in Tokyo Bay on 2 September 1945, concluding the Pacific war. In the aftermath, Germany was divided into East and West, with Berlin likewise partitioned, the Nazi regime was dissolved and its leaders faced the Nuremberg Trials; Japan retained its imperial structure but the militarists were purged and war‑criminals were tried in Tokyo and other tribunals. The Soviet Union installed communist regimes across Eastern Europe, forming a sphere of influence, while the United States established democratic allies in Western Europe, Japan, South Korea and elsewhere, creating a network of security partnerships. The Cold War standoff persisted from 1947 until 1991, characterized by nuclear deterrence, a space race and proxy conflicts across the globe. In sum, the Axis defeat reshaped the international order, institutionalised the United Nations as a multilateral security mechanism, and laid the groundwork for post‑war globalization, economic integration and the modern human‑rights regime.
